taskGoal: V3.10 B8 secure Provider credential storage and request-scoped Model Gateway credentials.
actualChanges: Provider writes now use opaque secretRef values backed by a credential store; legacy rows use write/read-back verification before the same database persistence clears api_key, and failure paths preserve the prior database/store state where the transaction can roll back.

Added Windows current-user DPAPI, explicit test/CI in-memory, unavailable-platform stores, provider cleanup coordination, and a startup legacy migration coordinator with a zero-plaintext assertion and idempotent rerun behavior.

Model Gateway canonical requests and OpenAI Responses, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, and Anthropic adapters consume only request-scoped credentials; API responses expose only configured/status information, and credential-like custom headers are rejected.
Added focused credential-store, migration, gateway-boundary, protocol-parity, provider-security, transaction, and H2 upgrade coverage.

verification.tests: Focused Maven credential, migration, gateway, protocol, provider-service, and H2 upgrade tests passed.
verification.manualCheck: git diff --check passed; production adapters have no direct getApiKey call; backend/.projectflow/config is absent after tests, so no credential artifact remains.
